title: Verify my client consumes real ACP messages
statement: As a developer building tools around AI harnesses, I can prescribe provider responses while my ACP tool or library exchanges messages with a real harness so that I can verify my own message handling and resulting behavior.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A prompt sent through the consumer under test produces a request at the mock provider; a prescribed text response is handled by the real harness and reaches the consumer through its ACP message path.
The test can observe ACP exchanges at the consumer boundary and distinguish them from provider API requests and responses, without requiring assertions against rendered CLI stdout.

For a supported tool scenario, the test can prescribe a provider tool call and verify the consumer handling of the resulting real ACP tool updates and any applicable client requests. Tool execution and permission handling follow the actual harness/client integration, not a fabricated tool result.
